description: This file declares a subset of CUDA BLAS functions as templates, including matrix multiplication (gemm), matrix-vector multiplication (gemv), dot products, and batched and specialized variants, with external dependencies on CUDA context and BLAS backend headers.

classes.name: PointerModeGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class that manages setting and restoring the CuBLAS pointer mode.

methods.name: gemm
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication with various specializations for data types.

methods.name: gemm_internal
methods.description: Internal implementation placeholder for gemm operations.

methods.name: gemm_and_bias
methods.description: Performs GEMM with optional bias and activation.

methods.name: scaled_gemm
methods.description: Performs scaled GEMM with scaling factors.

methods.name: vdot
methods.description: Computes vector dot product with complex types.
